messages:
jorge (sales): quick handoff — Canter Health signed for Dedicated (Q2 start). passing to CS for onboarding + support triage. key points: trial data stored in s3, needs SSO + SCIM, expected first 10k reqs/day, want <200ms p95, renewal in 11 months (multiyear likely). renewing contact: laura@canter.health. renewal risk: moderate if latency/cost not controlled.

mika (cs): thanks. copying owners — amanda will lead enablement, samir owns support ops.

amanda (cspm): noted. onboarding checklist items I need: account admin list, SSO metadata, any custom prompt templates. can jorge drop admin emails?

jorge (sales): admin list: laura, tony, priya. SSO metadata: ok sending in separate DM. they requested private VPC + dedicated capacity estimate in draft.

mika (cs): putting high-level next steps: 1) provision tenant in staging (samir + provision-bot) 2) test SSO + SCIM (amanda) 3) load sample dataset and run perf smoke (nia) 4) cost tuning session + batching plan (mika + eng) 5) kickoff with customer (amanda). aiming provisioning in 3 business days.

provision-bot: ticket INC-7123 created for tenant provisioning — assignee samir, ETA 72h.

samir (support): got it. I'll start provisioning tomorrow morning. question — is the model pinned to rwd-3-small or do they want larger?

jorge (sales): they approved rwd-3-small for now; might upgrade later. mention: some heavy embed use from analytics team.

nia (eng): for perf smoke — will need sample seq lengths and expected concurrency. can you add that, mika?

mika (cs): sample seqs: median 64 tokens, 95th 512. concurrency est: burst to 80 concurrent during daytime. adding to the ticket.

amanda (cspm): enablement doc draft: `canter_onboarding_v1.md` — will share PR in #docs after provisioning. also capturing feedback ops: we'll run a biweekly quality check and add eval prompts to Redwood Optimize.

jorge (sales): FYI, customer flagged compliance audit in 6 weeks — they want KMS integration tested before pilot.

samir (support): noted. I'll add KMS check to provisioning steps and escalate if HSM required.

mika (cs): owners + next steps recap: amanda = enablement + kickoff, samir = provisioning + KMS, nia = perf smoke + eng fixes, jorge = sales followups + compliance docs. I'll schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow 11am PT.

amanda (cspm): :thumbsup: I'll prepare the kickoff agenda and DM laura to confirm time.

jorge (sales): thanks team. ping here when provisioning ticket updated.

mika (cs): adding action item labels to INC-7123: `onboarding`, `kms-check`, `ssO`, `perf-smoke`. closing this handoff thread — reopen if blockers.
